an SEC registration statement for a continuous offering of up to $50M in Gemini Premium Yield Notes.
The unsecured debt notes will carry a floating interest rate, subject to adjustments with 30 days' notice.
The applicable interest rate and any changes will be disclosed in SEC-filed pricing supplements.
Gemini intends to use the proceeds primarily to fund margin loans that can be called on short notice.

title: Gemini files $50M offering of floating-rate yield notes
